name: 精密硬表面 · Precision Hard Surface

source_summary.provenance: Design interpretation from inspected local stills and/or the cited makers’ descriptions. Sources: https://www.maxon.net/en/article/using-maxon-one-for-future-facing-product-launches; https://tendril.studio/work/figure02/; https://futuredeluxe.com/work/audi

visual_rules.medium_behavior: 精密产品可视化CG，以摄影可读的硬表面和有依据的机械关系为中心。
palette_logic: 由目标工业材料与品牌色分配主次；中性空间让局部功能色有明确归属。
visual_rules.shape_line_language: 刚性壳体、倒角、接缝、孔隙与连接边界具有一致比例；几何细节依目标资料。
texture_material_logic: 拉丝方向随曲面与加工方向延续；金属、涂层、橡胶各有独立粗糙度。
亮面反射呈连续光带，暗面仍有形体；局部接触阴影帮助读清连接与层级。
visual_rules.lighting_logic: 以受控长条光带扫描曲率，局部轮廓光与负补光分离层件，背景从属于功能焦点。
composition_logic: 先读整体或关键轮廓，再进入连接/加工细节，最后回扣同一产品。
拆解或剖视只在目标明确允许且有结构依据时采用。
visual_rules.optics_rendering_logic: 有意识地切换产品透视与微距；虚拟镜头、焦点、反射和遮挡保持空间连续。
motifs: 沿真实曲率移动的反射带

inferred_traits: 把结构、工艺和功能因果读清，建立可信的精密感。
These rules are a transferable design interpretation, not the source creators’ complete production method.
unknowns: Exact source lens, shader parameters, simulation settings and full frame-by-frame motion are not established by these rules.
Image transfer does not establish temporal stability or final video quality.
transfer_rules: Target identity, material, geometry, function, palette, layout, text and requested medium remain authoritative.
Select compatible visual mechanisms; do not import every motif into every target.
forbidden_transfer: Source product identity, exact packaging, protected marks, source wording and layout coordinates.
不凭空补内部机构、尺寸、精度或性能；概念装置须说明是虚构设计，不能冒充真实工程证据。

prompts: 制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。三分之四近景，壳体前缘与接口同处清晰焦段；长条反射沿拉丝曲面延续，窄橙线只在侧面，暗背景有足够轮廓分离。 一块虚构无品牌便携固态硬盘，扁平矩形钛灰铝壳，四角小倒角，一端可见一个USB-C接口和一道细窄橙色状态线。
制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。低角度微距，刀头与螺钉的轴向对齐关系清楚，金属拉丝与黑色滚花尺度区分，连接处有窄而真实的接触阴影。 一把虚构无品牌精密扭矩螺丝刀，银色圆柱金属握柄、黑色滚花环、一个细短钢制刀头；刀头对齐一个独立螺钉。
validation.notes: Two different target scenarios were generated without source-image attachments and independently inspected. Static style transfer passed with recorded limitations. Actual PNGs are 1672x941; exact canvas, some framing/material-scale facts and moving-video behavior are not fully verified. This is not user adoption. See the validation record and separate evidence asset. Prompt entries are the target briefs; exact compiled native prompts and their SHA-256 are retained in the separate evidence asset.

evidence.review: A single rigid chamfered shell, directional brushing, continuous reflection band, one USB-C-shaped port and a narrow local orange line are visible. No internal circuit or engineering-performance claim is established.
Metal, knurling and bit have distinct surface scales; bit and screw align with a contact shadow. The upper handle is cropped and the screw rests on a plate rather than being fully isolated.
